overview: Finalize the endgame simulation loop by implementing deterministic state hashing for rapid save/load verification, optimizing the Monte Carlo convergence check for 100% survival rate validation, and compressing the 16,500-step footstep log into a bit-packed ring buffer to reduce memory footprint without loss of fidelity.

tasks.title: Bit-Packed Ring Buffer for Footstep Logs
tasks.architectural_spec:

2. `class FootstepLog` with `std::array<Footstep, 16500> buffer`.
3. `uint32_t head` and `uint32_t tail`.
4. `Push(const Footstep& f)` writes to `head`.
5. `Pop()` reads from `tail`.
6. `Size()` returns `head - tail`.
7. `IsFull()` checks `head - tail == 16500`.
8. `IsEmpty()` checks `head == tail`.
9. `Clear()` resets `head` and `tail`.
